run_visualize_results: run the visualization tool with --cfg and --thresh to generate detection result images
run_vis_function: run the vis function to visualize ground truth and predicted detections side by side
run_generate_visualizations: run _generate_visualizations to produce GT and predicted bounding box images for a single frame
run_convert_roidb_to_pred_boxes: run _convert_roidb_to_pred_boxes to append a confidence column to roidb bounding boxes
run_convert_roidb_to_pred_keyps: run _convert_roidb_to_pred_keyps to transform ground truth keypoints into visualization format
